pickaxe.description: The first digging tool. Breaks surface rocks and soft mineral deposits. Becomes insufficient for descending into hard layers.

flashlight.description: A rechargeable flashlight. The basic source of vision in deep tunnels and areas without sunlight.

laser_miner.description: Cuts even titanium and uranium deposits with a high-intensity laser. The indispensable tool for deep levels that a standard pickaxe cannot reach.

cable.description: Chromium-coated copper conductor. Thanks to its surface corrosion layer, it is resistant to moisture and chemicals. The backbone of all electrical systems.

titanium_plate.description: A high-strength structural panel. Used in pressure doors, ship hulls, and advanced production equipment.

electronic_circuit.description: A multi-purpose circuit board. The brain of bots, sensors, and automation systems. Production requires precision.

battery.description: A high-capacity lithium cell. Powers portable devices and exploration vehicles. A damaged cell carries a fire risk.

solar_panel.description: The basic renewable energy source. Installed on surfaces that receive sufficient sunlight. Non-functional in deep layers.

nuclear_reactor.description: Produces enough power to supply the entire base. Installation takes months, and operation requires expertise. A radiation suit is mandatory to approach the fuel core.

oxygen_generator.description: Continuously produces oxygen through electrolysis. Tank oxygen runs out, this doesn't. The lifeline of enclosed base modules.

medkit.description: A basic first aid kit. Stabilizes superficial injuries. Insufficient for serious fractures or internal bleeding.

radiation_suit.description: Mandatory equipment for approaching uranium zones and the nuclear reactor. The chromium-nickel layer absorbs gamma radiation to a large extent.

oxygen_tank.description: Provides limited breathing time in outdoor and unpressurized areas. An oxygen generator is required to refill it.

tank.description: A pressurized storage container. Used for water or oxygen, the content type is determined during installation. The titanium wall withstands high pressure.

water_filter.description: Carbon and quartz layers trap harmful substances and minerals. If the depleted carbon filter is not replaced, a poisoning risk arises.

temperature_stabilizer.description: Keeps the base's internal temperature within a livable range. No living module can be inhabited before it is installed in extremely hot or cold environments.

pressure_stabilizer.description: Preserves base integrity in deep water and high-pressure environments. A malfunction can result in a sudden implosion.

airlock.description: The transition chamber between the base and the outside environment. Enables entry and exit without disrupting the internal pressure and atmosphere. Without it, the pressure of the entire module drops with every exit.

storage.description: The module where minerals and produced materials are stored. Expands limited inventory capacity. Disorganized storage creates fire and contamination risks.

light_panel.description: A fixed lighting system mounted on base modules. Unlike a flashlight, it runs continuously. Also used as a growth light in farming modules.

cell.description: A new living or production module added to the base. Each cell requires independent pressure, temperature, and air management. The growth unit of the colony.

field.description: An indoor farming bench. Phosphorus and nitrogen are used as fertilizer. For yield, it must operate together with a light panel and water filter.

exploration_vehicle.description: Provides fast movement and mineral transport in the outside environment. Runs on two batteries; when depleted, you are forced to retreat to the base.
